run_multi_vector_retrieval_offline: run the multi_vector_retrieval_offline script to generate sentence-level embeddings using an embedding model like BAAI/bge-m3
run_token_embed: run the script with pooling_task='token_embed' to generate per-token embeddings for each prompt
create_llm_pooling: create an LLM instance with runner='pooling' for embedding model inference via argparse CLI
generate_sentence_embeddings: generate sentence-level embeddings by calling llm.embed(prompts) on a pooling runner LLM
generate_token_embeddings: generate per-token multi-vector embeddings by calling llm.encode(prompts, pooling_task='token_embed')
